import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from esda.moran import Moran
import libpysal as lps

# Load the dataset
DATASET_PATH = 'chunks_csv/moran_global_2023_crime.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(DATASET_PATH)

# Load the adjacency file
adjacency = pd.read_csv(ADJACENCY_PATH)

# Assuming the dataset has a column 'crime_rate' for the analysis
# Create a weights object from the adjacency data
weights = lps.weights.Queen.from_dataframe(df)

# Calculate Moran's I
moran = Moran(df['crime_rate'], weights)

# Get the Moran's I value and p-value
moran_i = moran.I
p_value = moran.p_sim

# Print the results
print(f"Moran's I = {moran_i}, p = {p_value}")
